summary_en: NSD completed cancellation of 3,000,000 shares on October 16, 2026. The cancelled shares represented 3.49% of issued shares before cancellation. Issued share capital after cancellation is 83,000,000 shares.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: NSD completed the cancellation of 3,000,000 treasury shares on October 16, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation was decided at a board meeting held on September 28, 2026. The cancelled shares represented 3.49% of the total issued shares (including treasury stock) before cancellation. Following completion, the company's total issued share capital stands at 83,000,000 shares.
